function: CSI feedback: an autoencoder compresses the downlink CSI at the UE and reconstructs it at the base station (p. 3).
system: Single-cell FDD massive MIMO-OFDM, ULA with Nt=32 BS antennas, one UE antenna, 1024 subcarriers; indoor 5.3 GHz and outdoor 300 MHz; no RIS (pp. 3, 10).
method: Convolutional autoencoder with Criss-Cross attention and depthwise-pointwise convolution (CRissNet, CRissNet+), trained end-to-end on reconstruction, described as unsupervised (p. 3).
data_channel: COST 2100 model, same dataset as CsiNet: indoor pico-cell 5.3 GHz and outdoor rural 300 MHz; 100,000 training, 30,000 validation, 20,000 test CSI matrices (p. 10).
test_conditions: Indoor and outdoor handled by separate trained models, several compression ratios; test set independently generated within the same scenario as training; no cross-scenario test (pp. 10-11).
baselines: Learned only: CsiNet, CRNet, ACRNet1x/10x, CLNet, CCA-Net-S, DS-NLCsiNet, CsiNetPlus, SALDR; no classical baseline, since CsiNet already beat compressed sensing (pp. 10-11).
metrics: NMSE between original and reconstructed CSI; model FLOPs; number of parameters (pp. 10-11).
complexity: FLOPs and parameters of every model in Tables I-II (CRissNet-S 3.18M FLOPs, 791k parameters at 1/8); SALDR has nearly tenfold more FLOPs (pp. 10-11).
openness: Code released at https://github.com/CRissNet/CRissNet.git (p. 1); data generated with COST 2100 as in CsiNet (p. 10).
q1_support: p. 10: "data is generated by COST2100 model [37]" (indoor pico-cell 5.3 GHz and outdoor rural 300 MHz).
q2_support: p. 10: "validation and test dataset are independently generated" within the same scenario; indoor and outdoor are trained and tested separately, and no test on another scenario, band, array size, or dataset is reported.
q3_support: p. 10: "this paper will not include the methods worse than that"; every method compared is learned (CsiNet, CRNet, CLNet, SALDR, and others), and no non-learned baseline is run.
q4_support: p. 11: "nearly tenfold increase in FLOPs compared to CRissNet"; Tables I-II (pp. 10-11) list FLOPs and parameters of every model.
notes: First page title matches the DOI (CRissNet, CSI feedback in massive MIMO). Tables I-V are not in the extracted text; values were read from page images of pp. 10-12. COST 2100 is on the q1 list of the instructions.
